page_title.browse: Short top-bar title of the Browse spaces page. It shares the bar with the search box on phones, so keep it to one short word.
__comment: Translator context notes (spec §30.2). Keys mirror en.json; values are short hints shown to translators in the Weblate editor. This file is NOT rendered in the UI. When a key in en.json has no matching entry here, Weblate falls back to the English source as sole context.
app.title: Product name — never translate.
nav.feed: Top-level nav label — keep short (≤ 10 chars). 'Feed' as in 'timeline', not 'food'.
nav.stickies: 'Sticky notes' on a shared pinboard. Keep short (≤ 10 chars).
spaces.create: Button label that opens the new-space wizard.
spaces.space_title: Fallback title shown when a space has no name set. Used very rarely.
pairing.enter_code: 6-digit SAS verification code after scanning the QR. Do not change the digit count.
pairing.show_qr: Shown above the QR code the peer is supposed to scan.
pairing.waiting: Shown in a spinner while waiting for the remote side to scan the QR.
calls.ringing: Caller-side label while the callee's device is ringing.
event.span.starts: Badge on the first day of a multi-day event in the day-by-day agenda. Very short (≤ 8 chars) — it sits in a pill next to the time.
event.span.ends: Badge on the last day of a multi-day event. Very short (≤ 8 chars).
event.span.day_of: Badge on the middle days of a multi-day event. {n} = this day's number, {total} = length of the whole event in days. Keep short — 'D2/3' is fine where the language has no compact wording.
event.span.from: Time hint on the first day of a multi-day event — the event starts at {time} and runs past midnight. Lowercase; it follows the date range on the same line.
event.span.until: Time hint on the last day of a multi-day event — it ends at {time}. Lowercase; follows the date range on the same line.
event.span.all_day: Time hint on a day a multi-day event covers from midnight to midnight. Lowercase; follows the date range on the same line.
event.span.aria: Screen-reader-only summary of where a row sits in a multi-day event. {range} is an already-formatted date range (e.g. '1–3 May').
presence.state.home: Presence value: physically at home (within the configured radius).
presence.state.away: Presence value: briefly away but still 'around' (e.g. gym, shops).
presence.state.not_home: Presence value: travelling, at work, etc.
presence.dnd: 'Do Not Disturb' — mutes push notifications. Keep pithy.
common.error: Generic error label, surfaced in toasts and inline.
common.retry: Button that re-triggers the failed operation.
common.not_now: 'Dismiss for now' — used in soft-promotion banners.
search.scope.post: Search filter: household feed posts (not space posts).
search.scope.space_post: Search filter: posts inside any space the user is a member of.
gfs.publish: 'Publish' a space to the Global Federation Server directory so strangers on the public internet can discover it.
gfs.unpublish: Opposite of publish — take the space back off the public directory.
space.federation: Settings-tab label inside a space — controls GFS publication + cross-household sharing.
space.retention_keep_legend: Space settings → Retention. Heading over checkboxes of post kinds that are never auto-deleted.
space.retention_keep_schedule: A 'schedule' post = a poll to find a date/time that suits everyone (Doodle-style).
space.retention_keep_event: The feed card auto-created for a calendar event (with RSVP buttons) — not the calendar entry itself.
dms.mute.menu_title: Heading of the menu that silences one chat (DM or group) for a while.
dms.mute.1h: Mute length option in the chat's mute menu.
dms.mute.8h: Mute length option in the chat's mute menu.
dms.mute.1w: Mute length option in the chat's mute menu.
dms.mute.forever: Mute length option: stays muted until the user unmutes it.
dms.mute.unmute: Button that turns a muted chat's notifications back on.
dms.mute.muted_until: Status of a muted chat. {time} is a clock time or a short date + time.
dms.mute.muted_forever: Status of a chat muted with no end time.
dms.mute.unmute_hint: Tooltip / screen-reader label of the bell-slash button. {state} is the muted status line.
dms.mute.section: Section heading in the group info dialog.
dms.mute.on: Shown in the group info dialog when the chat isn't muted.
dms.mute.error: Toast when the mute change failed (network / server).
dms.notif.heading: Group chat: heading above the two notification levels (All messages / Only @mentions).
dms.notif.all: Group chat notification level: every message notifies.
dms.notif.mentions: Group chat notification level: only messages that @mention you notify. Keep the @.
dms.notif.mentions_hint: Tooltip / screen-reader label of the thread header bell when the level is Only @mentions.
dms.notif.toast_all: Toast after switching a group back to All messages.
dms.notif.toast_mentions: Toast after switching a group to Only @mentions.
dms.mute.on_mentions: Group info Notifications section, not muted, level Only @mentions.
location.share_title: Title of the location picker dialog (chat and feed composer).
location.pick_on_map: Button: choose a place by tapping a map instead of using GPS.
location.precision_note: Privacy reassurance: coordinates are rounded to 4 decimals (~11 m).
location.accuracy: Shown under a shared pin; {m} is a coarse accuracy radius in metres.
dms.attach.menu: Paperclip button in the chat composer that opens the attach menu.
dms.location.send_failed: Toast; {error} is a technical error message.
connection.unreachable: Banner shown when the browser is online but the Social Home server can't be reached; the app keeps retrying in the background.
connection.retry: Button in the unreachable banner — reconnects immediately instead of waiting.
connection.reconnected: Short toast after the connection comes back.
shortcuts.menu_entry: Sidebar entry that opens the keyboard-shortcuts help dialog.
shortcuts.typing_note: Footnote in the shortcuts dialog: '/', 'n' and '?' do nothing while the cursor is in a text field.
theme.save_failed: Toast after a refused theme save. {error} = the server's reason (English, e.g. 'font_family must be one of: …').
theme.font.mono: Name of a monospace font style. Keep short.
theme.layout.magazine: Post layout name: roomy, reading-oriented cards. Keep short.
theme.font.inherit: Space theme font option: no font override, the space uses the household's font.
theme.corner_radius: Slider label. {px} = a number of pixels, 0–24.
space.proposal.owner_body: Approval banner sentence. {action} = one of the space.proposal.action.* / role.* / fwd.* phrases, already in the form that fits here (e.g. German zu-infinitive). Translate those phrases to read naturally inside this sentence.
space.proposal.admin_body: Same as space.proposal.owner_body; a majority of the space's admins must approve.
space.proposal.requested_by: {name} = the requester's display name, or space.proposal.requester_unknown.
space.proposal.requester_unknown: Fallback for {name} in space.proposal.requested_by when the requester's name isn't known.
space.proposal.role.moderator: Fills {action} in space.proposal.owner_body. {name} = a member's display name, or space.proposal.someone.
space.proposal.fwd.ban: Fills {action} in space.proposal.owner_body — like the other space.proposal.fwd.* / action.* phrases.
space.private_gfs.intro: One sentence above the private-space GFS switch introducing the term. Keep 'GFS' untranslated; the '(Global Federation Server)' expansion may stay in English.
space.followers.allow: Checkbox on a public space: lets anyone follow (read) it. 'Followers' read along but cannot post.
space.private_gfs.toggle: Owner-only switch on a private space. 'GFS' = the Global Federation Server; keep 'GFS' untranslated as a product name. The expansion is spelled out once in space.private_gfs.intro just above.
space.private_gfs.on: Heading over the explanation of the switch's ON state. Very short.
space.private_gfs.off: Heading over the explanation of the switch's OFF state. Very short.
invite.via.gfs: Invite link type: redeemed through the GFS (Global Federation Server), so households that never paired can join. Keep 'GFS' untranslated.
invite.via.internal: Invite link type shown to users as 'Local link': only households already connected (directly or through other households) can use it. Translate 'local' naturally; the API value stays 'internal'.
invite.via.badge_gfs: Small badge on an invite link row. Keep short.
invite.via.badge_internal: Small badge on an invite link row ('Local'). Keep short.
invite.via.badge_legacy: Small badge on a pre-existing invite link row. Keep short.
invite.via.badge_legacy_hint: Tooltip on the earlier-link badge: explains it still works and that using it turns the GFS on.
onboarding.step_of: Screen-reader label of the onboarding progress dots. {n} = current step, {total} = number of steps.
onboarding.gfs.title: Title of the optional onboarding step. 'GFS' is a product term — keep it untranslated.
onboarding.gfs.intro: First mention of the GFS on this screen, so it is spelled out once as 'GFS (Global Federation Server)'. Keep 'Global Federation Server' in English.
onboarding.gfs.checkbox: Label of the opt-out checkbox (ticked by default). {server} = the GFS host name, e.g. gfs.social-home.io.
onboarding.gfs.default_note: 'Settings → Connections' must match the app's navigation labels in your language.
time.expired: Short status for something whose time ran out (an invite link). Lowercase; may stand alone in a row after a '·'.
time.on_date: Used for a date more than a month ahead. {date} is a localized short date like 'Jan 5, 2027'. Lowercase; it follows a verb like 'expires' / 'stops working'.
invite.role.legend: Heading above the role choices (Member, Follower, Moderator, Admin) for people who join with this invite link.
invite.expiry.7d: Option in a 'Stops working after …' picker. In German, dative fits the label ('nach 7 Tagen').
invite.publish.toggle: Checkbox label. {server} = the display name of a GFS (Global Federation Server).
invite.publish.unavailable: Picker option for a GFS that can't host invite links. {server} = its display name.
invite.created.uses: Plural form (count not 1). {n} = how many people can still join with the new link. Paired with invite.created.uses_one.
invite.created.uses_one: Singular form, used when the count is in the language's 'one' category (French: 0 and 1). {n} = the count.
invite.created.expires: {when} is a localized relative time like 'in 7 days' or 'on Jan 5, 2027' (from Intl.RelativeTimeFormat / time.on_date). 'It' = the invite link.
invite.created.joins_as: Fallback for an unknown role name sent by the server. {role} = that raw name.
invite.created.web_link_limit: {days} = number of days the GFS keeps a published invite (30).
invite.links.uses_left: Row metadata in the list of active invite links. Plural form; {n} = remaining people who can join. Paired with _one.
invite.links.uses_left_one: Singular form ('one' plural category). {n} = the count.
invite.links.uses_of: {n} = remaining, {total} = how many the link was made for. Only shown when total is at least 2, so no singular variant.
invite.links.expires: Row metadata, lowercase, between '·' separators. {when} = localized relative time like 'in 7 days'.
invite.links.by: Row metadata: who made the link. {name} = a person's display name.
space.retention.days_hint: Follows a number input; the unit 'days' comes first.
space.retention.placeholder: Placeholder inside the days field when posts are kept forever. Keep very short.
space.post_type.schedule: A poll for picking a date/time (like Doodle).
space.post_type.highlight_share: A post that shares a short-lived highlight (story-like clip) to the feed.
space.location.zone_badge: Tiny badge next to 'Zone only'. Very short (≤ 14 chars).
space.admin_authority.legend: Section title: the owner lets space admins act on their behalf while the owner is offline.
space.tier.private: Option in a select; keep the 'Name — explanation' shape.
space.dissolve.button: 'Dissolve' = permanently delete the space for everyone.
space.version_banner.body: Followed by a comma-separated list of feature names (shown in English).
onboarding.welcome.illus_household: Sample household name on an illustration card. Use the natural way to name a family in your language.
onboarding.feed.illus_meta: Sample post meta on an illustration: 'posted in <space name> · <time ago>'. 'Family' is a sample space name.
onboarding.lists.illus_date: Sample calendar date on an illustration card (a Sunday). Short weekday + date.
onboarding.connect.illus_meta: Sample caption under a pairing QR code: the code is encrypted and expires in 5 minutes (5:00 = mm:ss countdown).
space.settings_page.title: Page heading. {name} = the space's name.
space.settings_page.tab_about: Settings tab for the space's description / about text. Short.
space.members.invite_by_code: Button in a space's member list that opens the invite-link dialog. Shown after a '+'.
space.create.visibility: Legend over the visibility choices (Private / Household / Public / Global) in the create-space dialog.
space.create.gfs_hint_before: Text before a link. The full sentence is gfs_hint_before + gfs_hint_link (the link) + gfs_hint_after. Reorder words freely across the three parts; any part may be empty.
space.create.gfs_hint_link: Link text that opens the Connections page. See space.create.gfs_hint_before.
space.create.gfs_hint_after: Text after the link (often just a period). See space.create.gfs_hint_before.
space.create.min_age_value: Minimum-age option in a dropdown. {age} = 13, 16 or 18. E.g. '18+'.
space.create.discovery: Section heading: settings that help strangers find a public space (category, minimum age).
space.category.general: Discovery category for a public space. Short; shown in a dropdown and on space cards.
space.category.local: Discovery category: spaces about a town or neighborhood.
space.members.count: Member list heading for 0 or 2+ members. {n} = number. Singular form is space.members.count_one.
space.members.count_one: Member list heading for exactly one member (French also uses it for 0). {n} = number.
space.members.you: Small lowercase chip next to your own name in the member list.
space.members.joined_on: Shown under a member who joined over a year ago. {date} = short month + year, e.g. 'Apr 2024'.
space.members.banned_heading: Section heading above people banned from the space. Plural.
space.members.banned_badge: Short red badge on one banned person's row.
remote_invite.from: Follows the space name in a pending-invite row. {name} = the person or household who invited you; shown in bold.
remote_invite.an_admin: Used as {name} in remote_invite.from when the inviter is unknown.
remote_invite.last_seen: {when} = a relative time like '5 min ago' (time.* keys).
remote_invite.weeks_ago: Very short relative time, like time.days_ago. {n} = weeks.
remote_invite.confirm_decline: Second click on Decline to confirm. Short button label.
remote_invite.minutes_ago: Very short relative time after 'last seen'. {n} = minutes.
space.about.text_hint: 'Markdown' is a text-formatting syntax name — keep it as is.
space.about.write: Label above the text editor (next to the Preview pane).
space.about.placeholder: Placeholder in the Markdown editor. Keep the leading '# ' (it makes a heading) and the blank line (\n\n).
space.age.no_restriction: Option in the minimum-age picker; the other options are '13+', '16+', '18+'.
space.bots.intro: 'Home Assistant' is a product name — never translate. 'Token' = a secret key the user pastes into Home Assistant.
space.bots.turn_on_first: Quotes the space.bots.allow label — keep both in sync.
space.bots.use_service: Followed by a Home Assistant service name in code font, e.g. "Use notify.social_home_doorbell".
space.bots.rotate: Button that replaces the bot's secret token with a new one.
space.bots.slug: Machine-friendly short name: lowercase letters, digits, - and _ only.
space.bots.slug_hint: Followed by the service name in brackets, e.g. "(notify.social_home_doorbell)."
connections.status.pending_sent: Pairing status: we showed a QR code, the other household hasn't scanned it yet.
connections.status.pending_received: Pairing status: we scanned their code, waiting for them to confirm.
connections.compat.up_to_date: Short badge: the other household runs a version with every feature. Keep the ✓.
connections.compat.behind: Short badge. {n} = number of features the other household is missing because it runs an older version (n ≠ 1). Hovering shows the list.
connections.compat.unknown: Short badge: we don't know yet which version the other household runs.
connections.compat.households_behind: Screen-reader label for the badge next to 'Households'. {n} ≠ 1.
connections.transport.direct: How messages reach the other household: a fast direct connection.
connections.transport.internet: How messages reach the other household when a direct connection isn't possible.
connections.transport.gfs: Messages go through the GFS server. Keep 'GFS' untranslated.
connections.detail.alias_label: Label of a text field where an admin gives another household a local nickname.
connections.detail.alias_own_name: {name} = the name the other household chose for itself.
connections.detail.household_id: Label for a technical identifier of the other household.
connections.detail.address: Label: the web address where the other household receives messages.
connections.detail.paired: Label next to the date the two households were paired.
connections.detail.missing_features: Label before a list of features the other household doesn't have yet.
connections.detail.gfs_only: Short chip: messages only went through the GFS server so far.
connections.detail.gfs_last_handed: {time} = date and time when the GFS last took a message for this household.
connections.detail.connection: Label: how messages travel to this household.
connections.detail.chat_route: Label: which household the last direct message passed through.
connections.detail.chat_route_hint: {via} = name of the household in between. {time} = relative time, e.g. '5 minutes ago'.
connections.detail.toast_visible: {user} = a member of your household. {name} = the other household.
connections.detail.toast_hidden: {user} = a member of your household. {name} = the other household.
connections.detail.admin: Small tag next to a member's name.
connections.view: Screen-reader label for the List / Map switch.
connections.requests.wants_to_pair: {name} = the new household, shown in bold.
connections.requests.introduced_by: {name} = the household that introduced them, shown in bold.
connections.pair_via_peer: Button: ask a household you already know to introduce you to another one.
connections.type.household: Small type tag on a connection card.
connections.type.space_only: Small type tag: this household only shares a space with you, nothing else.
connections.type.gfs: Small type tag for a GFS server. Keep 'GFS' untranslated.
connections.ext.title: Section title: the web address other households use to reach this Social Home.
connections.ext.effective: {url} = a web address shown as code. Keep {url} in the sentence.
connections.ext.from_config: Appended after the address. Starts with a space.
connections.ice.title: Servers that help two households find a way to reach each other.
connections.ice.state_ready: Short badge: a server that passes traffic along when a direct connection fails is ready.
connections.ice.kind_backup_signed_in: Short note next to a server address.
connections.ice.kind_backup_no_login: Short note next to a server address.
connections.ice.kind_lookup: Short note next to a server address (a STUN server).
connections.ice.hint_no_turn: Keep STUN and TURN as they are.
connections.ice.from_ha: Appended to the previous hint. Starts with a space.
nav.section.home: Sidebar section header for household tools (feed, calendar, tasks…). Short (≤ 14 chars).
nav.section.talk: Sidebar section header for chats and calls. One short word.
nav.section.browse: Sidebar section header for spaces, friends, bazaar, apps. One short word.
nav.section.settings: Sidebar section header above Personal / Connections / Admin. Short.
nav.organize: Sidebar link to the hub with tasks, shopping list and sticky notes. Short (≤ 12 chars).
nav.chats: Sidebar and bottom-tab link to direct messages. Short (≤ 10 chars).
nav.corner: Sidebar link to the user's personal dashboard ('my corner'). Short.
nav.home: Bottom tab on phones that opens the welcome page. ≤ 8 chars.
nav.notifications_short: Bottom tab on phones for notifications. Must fit a narrow tab: ≤ 9 chars.
nav.more: Bottom tab on phones that opens the full menu. ≤ 8 chars.
nav.unread: Screen-reader label on an unread badge. {count} = number.
nav.parent_control: Sidebar link for guardians to manage a child's account. Short.
space.tab.moderation: Space tab where moderators review reported or held posts. One short word (≤ 11 chars).
space.tab.map: Space tab showing members' shared locations on a map. Short.
space.header.members: Member count in the space header. {count} = number. Plural form; the _one key is the singular.
space.header.members_one: Singular of space.header.members. {count} = 1 (0 and 1 in French).
composer.submit.post: Submit button of the post composer. One short word.
connections.detail.you: Start of a route: You → other household → them.
connections.global_servers: Section heading on the connections page. 'GFS (Global Federation Server)' is a product term: keep it untranslated.
composer.context.space: Small badge in the post box: the post goes to this space. One word.
composer.context.household: Small badge in the post box: the post goes to the household feed. One word.
calendar.prev_month: Screen-reader label of the ‹ button in the calendar header. The other prev_/next_ keys work the same for week and day views.
calendar.empty_space_hint: Empty space calendar. Quote the 'New event' button label (calendar.new_event) as it reads in your language.
composer.drop.hint_image: Dropzone text, followed directly by a link 'choose a photo…'. Together they read 'Drag photos here, or choose a photo…'. Lowercase link.
composer.drop.hint_video: Followed by the link 'choose a file…'.
composer.drop.hint_file: Followed by the link 'choose a file…'.
composer.edit: Small lowercase link after a summary line like '3 times proposed — edit'.
composer.schedule_summary: Date poll draft in the composer. {n} = number of proposed date/time slots. Followed by ' — edit'.
composer.poll_options: Poll draft in the composer, after the question. {n} = number of answer options.
composer.over_limit: After the character counter '520/500' when the post is too long. Keep very short, in brackets.
map.tile_error: Shown over a map when its tiles fail to load. Reloading the page is the fix.
modal.close: Screen-reader label for the ✕ button of every dialog.
search.bar_placeholder: Placeholder in the top-bar search box. A 🔍 is put in front.
page_title.welcome: Top-bar title of the home page.
spaces.list.subscribed: Section heading for spaces the user follows read-only (subscriber role). Followed by ' · ' and spaces.list.subscribed_hint.
spaces.list.subscribed_pill: Short badge on a followed space. Keep short (≤ 12 chars). A 🔔 goes in front.
spaces.list.remote_chip: Badge on a space hosted by another household. Keep short.
time.hours_ago_short: Compact 'hours ago' in byline rows (Pages, notifications). {n} = whole hours.
time.yesterday: Lowercase; stands alone in a byline row.
time.days_ago_long: Plural; time.days_ago_long_one is the singular (French also uses it for 0).
welcome.greet.morning_named: Home-page greeting. {name} = the user's first name. The other welcome.greet.* keys work the same (night is before 5:00 and after 22:00).
welcome.shape.to_read: {items} is a list like '2 messages · 3 alerts'. Lowercase; it follows the date: 'Sunday, October 4 · 2 messages to read'.
welcome.shape.next_day: {day} is a weekday ('Monday') or a short date ('Oct 12'). Lowercase start; it follows the date after ' · '.
welcome.sub.all_clear: Lowercase; follows the date: 'Sunday, October 4 · all clear'.
welcome.ago.minutes: Very short age of a post in a list ('5m'). Keep ≤ 6 chars. Same for hours and days.
welcome.chip.messages: Word after a bold number in a chip ('3 messages'). welcome.chip.messages_one is the singular.
welcome.card.catch_up: Card heading on the home page with unread messages, alerts and new space posts.
capability.calendar_time_zones: One of the 'Missing features' a household on an older Social Home version lacks (connection details, space banner). Every capability.* key is a short noun phrase, under ~50 characters, joined with ', ' in a list.
settings.profile.change: Hover hint on the profile picture, after a 📷 emoji. Very short.
settings.following.since: Followed by a relative time like '3 days ago' in a separate element.
settings.blocked.since: Followed by a relative time like '3 days ago' in a separate element.
settings.momentum.hop_1: How far a moment may travel through connected households to reach you. 1 step = straight from a household you're connected to.
settings.ha_notify.help: {code} is replaced by the literal code 'notify.mobile_app_…'. 'Developer Tools → Actions' are Home Assistant menu names — use HA's own translation of them.
settings.language.help: {link} is replaced by the link text from settings.language.contribute.
space.card.hosted_by: Followed by the host household's name in bold, e.g. 'Hosted by The Smiths'. The household that runs this space.
space.card.follow: Button: follow a space read-only (you get its posts but can't post). Same wording as 'Following' / 'Unfollow' elsewhere.
dashboard.bazaar.ending_soon: Label under a count of listings that end within the next 24 hours. Keep very short.
calendar.page.owner_you: Small chip naming whose calendar an event is on — here, the viewer's own.
bazaar.create.mode: Label for the pricing type of a marketplace listing (fixed price, auction, …).
join_requests.asked: {when} is a relative time like '5 min ago' / 'yesterday', already translated.
secret.warning_body: About a one-time secret (API token or private calendar link). 'Fingerprint' = a hash; keep it non-technical.
pairing.sas_display_label: Accessible label for the 6-digit code both admins read out loud to confirm the pairing. Keep 'six digits' accurate.
pairing.or_divider: Divider between 'scan QR' and 'share a code'. One short word, often uppercase.
pairing.step_start: Step label in a 5-step progress bar. Keep very short (≤ 10 chars).
pairing.step_show: Step label in a 5-step progress bar. Keep very short (≤ 10 chars).
pairing.step_scan: Step label in a 5-step progress bar. Keep very short (≤ 10 chars).
pairing.step_verify: Step label in a 5-step progress bar. Keep very short (≤ 10 chars).
pairing.step_done: Step label in a 5-step progress bar. Keep very short (≤ 10 chars).
event.recurring_chip: {freq} = one of event.rrule.daily / weekly / monthly / yearly.
event.reminder.minutes_label: Compact chip. {n} = number of minutes before the event start.
event.reminder.days_label: Compact chip. {n} = number of days. Abbreviate the unit.
event.reminder.weeks_label: Compact chip. {n} = number of weeks. Abbreviate the unit.
event.subscribe.steps.apple.1: Menu path in Apple Calendar (macOS). Use the app's real menu names in your language.
event.subscribe.steps.google.1: Menu path in Google Calendar on the web. Use the real UI labels in your language.
event.subscribe.steps.outlook.1: Menu path in Outlook. Use the real UI labels in your language.
event.subscribe.steps.thunderbird.1: Menu path in Thunderbird. Use the real UI labels in your language.
event.subscribe.app.apple: Product name — keep as the vendor names it in your language.
recoveryKit.title: 'Recovery Kit' = one encrypted backup file (.shrk) that restores the whole household. Translate it as a plain noun.
setup.household_name_placeholder: Example family name as a placeholder. Use a common surname-style example in your language.
media.post_image: Fallback alt text for an image in a post when the author gave none (noun, not a verb).
highlight.picker.empty_before: Sentence split around a link. Full English: 'You don't have any active highlights yet. Post one from [Highlights → New] first.' empty_after follows the link and may be just a period.
highlight.picker.empty_after: Text after the link 'Highlights → New'. Often just '.' in other languages.
highlight.frames: Count of photos/videos in a highlight (a short story). {n} = number.
lightbox.copy_reference: Copies a short code that shows this photo when pasted into a Page (wiki page). Keep short — it's a button label.
moment.composer.share_public: Checkbox label. {n} = number of GFS servers this household is registered with (2 or more). Keep 'GFS' untranslated.
connections.map.you_pin: Text inside the small round map pin that marks your own household. Very short (≤ 4 chars).
space.notif.trigger: Tooltip / screen-reader name of the bell button on a space. {level} = one of space.notif.level_*.
space.public.hosted_by: Follows the member count on the space's public page: '5 members · hosted by Miller family'. Lowercase.
space.public.scope_global: Chip for a space listed in the worldwide directory (via a GFS). Short.
spaces.browse.from_friends: Tab on Browse spaces: public spaces shared by households you're connected with. Short.
spaces.browse.your_household: Tab on Browse spaces and the name shown for spaces your own household hosts.
space.join_landing.wrong_body: “Join with code” must match the button on the Spaces page (spaces.list.join_code).
status.clear_30m: Chip in 'Clear after' picker. Very short.
setup.strength.empty: Read by screen readers when the password field is empty: 'Password strength: empty'.
handle.title: '@handle' = the public @-name people use to find/mention you.
security.saved_it: Button that dismisses the one-time token reveal.
admin.queue.reported_as: Admin moderation queue row: '<Post> reported as spam by Bob'. {category} is one of admin.queue.category.* (lowercase in English), {reporter} a name or admin.queue.reporter_*.
admin.queue.reporter_other: Fills {reporter} in admin.queue.reported_as — use the grammatical case that fits after 'by'.
admin.queue.reporter_member: Fills {reporter} in admin.queue.reported_as — use the grammatical case that fits after 'by'.
admin.spaces.col.join: Admin table column header: how people join the space (open / request / invite only).
admin.tab.ha_users: Admin tab listing Home Assistant users. HA = Home Assistant; keep short.
autopair.other_household: Fallback for {target} in autopair.pending_body / autopair.queued_body when no name was typed. German uses dative ('bei dem anderen Haushalt' → 'von dem anderen Haushalt'); adjust the sentences if the case doesn't fit.
autopair.pending_title: {via} = name of the already-connected household that introduces the two households.
bazaar.card.left_minutes: Countdown pill on an auction card. {m} = minutes. Very short.
bazaar.card.left_hours: Countdown pill. {h} = hours, {m} = minutes. Very short.
bazaar.card.left_days: Countdown pill. {d} = days, {h} = hours. Very short.
bazaar.offers.status.pending: Small lowercase status pill next to the buyer's own offer.
calendar.import.target_yours: Fills {target} in calendar.import.added / imported. German: dative ('in deinem Kalender gespeichert').
calendar.import.target_other: Fills {target} in calendar.import.added / imported. {name} = owner of the calendar. German: dative.
event.dialog.invite_none_before: Sentence is split around a link: before + link (event.dialog.invite_none_link) + after.
bazaar.status.active: Listing status filter / tile badge. A 'listing' (Anzeige) is feminine in fr ('annonce').
comments.post: Button that sends a new comment.
gallery.albums_word: Follows a bold number: '3 albums · 12 photos and videos'. Lowercase word only.
gallery.media_word: Follows a bold number in the gallery header. Lowercase word only.
gallery.kept: Badge on an album that is never cleaned up automatically (exempt from retention).
gallery.album_empty_body_before: Followed by the bold button label '+ Upload' and then album_empty_body_after.
highlight.publish.no_gfs_before: Sentence split around a link to Settings → Connections. no_gfs_after follows the link.
poll.closes_in_min: Countdown under a poll; {n} = minutes left. Keep very short.
poll.closes_in_hours: Countdown under a poll; {n} = hours left. Keep very short.
poll.closes_in_days: Countdown under a poll; {n} = days left. Keep very short.
post.via: Byline under an automation's post. {name} = 'Home Assistant' or the member who set the automation up.
time.your_time: Shown under an event time when the event's timezone differs from the reader's. {time} = the time in the reader's timezone.
upload.network: {lead} = upload.lead or upload.lead_file. Same for the other upload.* messages.
toast.occurrences: Screen-reader label for the '× 3' badge on a toast that fired several times.
md.ph.bold: Placeholder text inserted into the editor when the user clicks Bold with nothing selected. Same for the other md.ph.* keys.
network_map.stats: Counts of other households: paired, reachable now, waiting for approval.
alias.lead_before: Text before the person's name (in bold) in the nickname dialog. Full sentence: '{lead_before}<name>{lead_after}'. Keep the trailing space.
alias.lead_after: Text after the person's name in the nickname dialog; see alias.lead_before. Keep the leading space.
calls.error_reason: Error toast: {prefix} is a short failure line such as "Couldn't start the call", {reason} the cause. Keep the separator natural for your language.
calls.quality.good: Connection quality badge during a call (lowercase, one word).
calls.status.ringing: Shown on a group-call tile while that person's device rings.
calls.state.ringing: Lowercase status word in a call-history row (one per call).
dms.tab.dms: Tab for 1:1 direct-message chats. Very short.
dms.badge.dm: Small badge on a 1:1 chat row (vs. 'Group · 3'). Very short.
dms.status.last_seen: Chat header for an offline person. {ago} is a relative time such as 'just now' or '5 min ago' (time.* keys).
dms.jump_new: Tiny label under the count on the 'jump to newest' chip (e.g. '3 new'). Very short.
dms.day.aria: Screen-reader label of a day separator. {day} is 'Today', 'Yesterday', a weekday or a date.
dms.group.home: Label under a group member who lives in YOUR household (others show 'at <household>').
friends.hero.across: Friends page headline: '<17> people across <4> households'. The bold numbers sit around this word. German needs the dative plural in friends.hero.households ('in 4 Haushalten').
friends.paired_ago: Under a connected household. {ago} is a relative time ('5 min ago') or a date.
presence.clears: After a status line: when the status expires. {time} is a clock time, or weekday + time (e.g. 'Mon 18:00').
presence.dnd_badge: Small badge for 'Do Not Disturb'. Keep very short.
search.filter.dms: Search filter chip for direct (private) messages.
moment.archive.hashtag_hint_before: Split around a code sample: 'Start a hashtag with #yourtag to make it easy to find later.' hashtag_example is the placeholder tag word (no spaces, no #).
moment.archive.empty_tag: {tag} = hashtag without the leading #. 'Recent' = moments still kept (they expire after 1–7 days).
moment.time.now: Compact timestamp in a dense list for something posted under a minute ago. Keep very short.
pairing.reach.legend: Legend of the radio group on the pairing start screen: how the other household reaches this one (direct URL / via the GFS). GFS = Global Federation Server, never translate the acronym.
pairing.reach.gfs_warning: Calm, informational note (not an error) shown when a GFS option is picked. Keep the meaning: the GFS sees timing and volume, never content.
pairing.scan.uses_gfs: Shown to the scanning admin. {host} is a server host name such as gfs.example.com.
pairing.error.gfs_not_shared: {host} is the GFS host name from the scanned code.
